title: Prostage Remote Volume

controlChangeCommands.name: Volume
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Expression pedal / Initial Position. Prostage foot controllers can use Hi Res pitch bend instead for higher resolution.

controlChangeCommands.name: Keep Init
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Do Not Change Initial Position — keep volume from previous preset on PC recall.

x_pc.additionalInfo: PC 0–127 = 128 presets. Store via SysEx (F0 00 20 75 00 7F [XX] F7), not CC.

additionalInfo: Prostage Remote Volume (VCA) manual §6. 5-pin DIN MIDI In + Out/Thru (Thru by default; Out for System Manager dump). Factory Omni; channel via SysEx F0 00 20 75 00 70 XY F7. Pitch bend = Hi Res volume (recognized per MIDI implementation chart).
